name: How long does water heater leak repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does water heater leak repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of water heater leak repair depends on the specific issue. Simple fixes, such as tightening a connection or replacing a pressure relief valve, might take an hour or two. More complex repairs or a full water heater replacement could take several hours. Our technicians in the Las Vegas area aim for efficient service, and we can provide a more accurate time estimate after diagnosing the exact problem on-site.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; simple fixes take 1-2 hours, while complex repairs or replacement may take several hours. An estimate is given after diagnosis.
